messages.subject: Ritu | Energy Transition & Infrastructure Executive | Government Relations, ESG and Global Mobility
messages.body:
Dear Ritu,

Your leadership within Amrop's Energy and Infrastructure practice, together with your policy-advocacy and renewable-energy background, makes this a focused introduction. I am pursuing senior international mandates where energy transition, institutional relations and ESG execution sit close to business strategy.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My remit spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, external and corporate affairs, strategic stakeholder engagement and executive communications within a major gold-mining operation.

My portfolio includes stakeholder governance around approximately 46-50 MWp of solar capacity, more than 80 MWh of battery storage and carbon-data readiness. I also work extensively across public institutions and regulators, converting external requirements into clear internal owners, evidence and follow-through.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates across Government Affairs, External Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships and Country Leadership in energy, infrastructure, mining and industrial sectors. I am internationally mobile, with strong interest in the Middle East and wider international markets.

I have attached an Amrop-tailored executive CV and would value consideration for suitable current or upcoming searches.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
